question.text: For the reaction <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mn>4</mn></msub><mo>(</mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>⇌</mo><mn>2</mn><msub><mi>NO</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>(</mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mo>)</mo></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>492</mn><mo> </mo><mi>atm</mi></math> at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>300</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mo>.</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi></msub></math> for the reaction at same temperature is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math>. (Given :<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>082</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi><mo> </mo><mi>atm</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi>mol</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>)

solution.text:
The given reaction is,

 N2O4( g)⇌2NO2( g)

Kp=0.492 atm

T=300 K

KP=KC·(RT)Δng

Δng= number of gaseous molecules of products – number of gaseous molecules of reactants.

Δng=1

By putting the values in the above equation,

⇒Kc=KpRT=0.4920.082×300=2×10-2
